page.title: Izixhumi
page.intro: Xhuma ama-akhawunti akho okukhangisa. Ukuhola okuvela ezikhangisweni zakho kufika kokuthi I-My Leads ngokuzenzekelayo, nezindleko nezindleko zomthofu ngamunye.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form iholela kokuthi Ukuhola Kwami, ukuchitha kwansuku zonke nezindleko zomthofu ngamunye, kanye nekhwalithi yomthofu ibuyiselwe ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn ixhunyiwe. Ukuhola kulandwa manje - leli khasi libuyekeza ngokushesha.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ayikamiswa kule seva okwamanje. Umlawuli kufanele engeze ID yeklayenti lohlelo lokusebenza lwe LinkedIn kanye nemfihlo.
banner.expired: Uxhumo lwe LinkedIn luphelelwe yisikhathi, ngakho imikhondo ayivumelanisi. Xhuma kabusha ukuze uqhubeke.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn idinga ukuthi uphinde ungene ngemvume ngomhla ka {{date}} . Xhuma kabusha ngaphambi kwalokho ukuze ugcine imikhondo igeleza.

connect.title: Xhuma i LinkedIn
connect.intro: Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti LinkedIn ephethe izikhangiso zakho. Leadrat ifunda kuphela ama-akhawunti akho ezikhangiso, Lead Gen Form nezibalo zesikhangiso, futhi ithumela ukuguqulwa okuvulayo.
connect.need1: Indima ku-akhawunti yesikhangiso se LinkedIn (Umbukeli noma ngaphezulu).
connect.need2: Indima ekhasini lenkampani elixhunyiwe (Umlawuli, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Umlondolozi noma Umhlaziyi) - LinkedIn idinga ukuthi yabelane ngemikhondo.
connect.need3: Umbuzo wenombolo yocingo ku- Lead Gen Forms yakho - ukuhola ngaphandle kwenombolo yocingo akunakungezwa.

connection.title: Ukuxhumana
connection.autoRenews: Ukufinyelela kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuze kube yileso sikhathi
connection.syncResult: Ukuvumelanisa kwenziwe: {{received}} kwamukelwe, {{created}} kudaliwe, {{duplicates}} impinda, {{rejected}} kwenqatshiwe.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Nqamula i LinkedIn ? Izitobhi zokuvumelanisa kanye namathokheni okufinyelela ayasuswa. Ukuhola, izibalo kanye nelogi yomsebenzi kugcinwa.
connection.noPermission: Ungabuka leli khasi. Ukuxhuma nokushintsha izilungiselelo kudinga imvume "yokuphatha izilungiselelo".
connection.fetchHint: Imikhondo emisha iyahlolwa njalo ngemizuzu embalwa futhi izinsuku zokugcina eziyi-7 zibuye zihlolwe nsuku zonke, ngakho-ke akukho okugejiwe. Sebenzisa lokhu ukuthola imikhondo yangaphambi kokuthi uxhume, noma uhlole isikhathi futhi (kufika ezinsukwini ezingama-90 ngesikhathi). Ukuhola osekuvele ku- Leadrat kweqiwe.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} itholiwe, {{created}} idaliwe, {{duplicates}} impinda, {{rejected}} inqatshiwe, {{skipped}} isivele ingenisiwe.

accounts.title: Ama-akhawunti ezikhangiso
accounts.intro: Ukuhola nezibalo kuvumelaniswa kusukela kuma-akhawunti ezikhangiso avulwe lapha.
accounts.none: Awekho ama-akhawunti esikhangiso atholakele kule akhawunti LinkedIn . Hlola indima ye-akhawunti ku- LinkedIn Campaign Manager , bese uvuselela.
accounts.name: I-akhawunti yesikhangiso

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tshela LinkedIn ukuthi yimuphi umkhondo wayo owaba yithemba langempela. Uma ukuhola LinkedIn kufinyelela esimweni osikhetha ngezansi, Leadrat ibika ku LinkedIn , ukuze imibiko yomkhankaso wakho ibonise ikhwalithi yokuhola futhi LinkedIn ingathola abantu abaningi abafana nabaphambili bakho. Kuthunyelwa ID eholayo ye LinkedIn kanye ne-hashi yendlela eyodwa ye-imeyili.
capi.created: Ukuguqulwa kudalwe ku- LinkedIn futhi kwafakwa imephu.

activity.title: Ilogi yomsebenzi
activity.intro: Yonke into phakathi Leadrat ne LinkedIn : ukuxhumana, konke ukuvumelanisa, konke ukuhola kanye nokwenzekile kukho, ukuguqulwa namaphutha.
